entries.sourceGenerationPrompt: Create version A: a faithful SOURCE-VIEW extraction of the REAL NECA Ultimate LASERSHOT Predator (2019) removable rigid mask, from the MASKED INSET AT THE UPPER RIGHT of this official white catalog photograph. The large full-body figure is UNMASKED and is only evidence for what to exclude. Do NOT turn that unmasked violet face or its red cybernetic eye into a new mask. Copy the actual mask shell in the small top-right inset, preserving its nearly frontal slight three-quarter/downward camera, its silhouette and named edition paint. The rigid shell has a warm weathered copper/bronze outer frame, layered pale old-gold forehead shield panels with a narrow center fastener/seam line, an angular arching bronze brow, open angled eye/temple windows, and a compact rounded copper lower face around an elongated central DARK GRILLE with a few repeated raised mechanical ridges. That repeated dark grille is a MATERIAL part seated in the bronze frame, not a mouth or an alpha hole. Keep the source modest repeated relief only, no elaborate invented filigree, glyphs or screws. Remove the visible organic green/purple face, skin, red left optical implant/LED, eyeballs and mandible tusks inside the eye windows: those openings must become genuinely transparent voids. Do not copy the red eye as shell pigment or add glow. Remove ALL dreadlocks, scalp behind helmet, neck/throat/collar, shoulder armor, body, toys/accessories, source catalog text or white background. Hidden rear/interior is not shown: do not invent it. Keep the real bronze/copper and worn gold paint in the inset, restrained dark seams, small known center fasteners only; no recoloring toward silver, saturated orange or neon. The source mask is small, around148x163px: retain its broad squat proportions and visible design without claiming or inventing microscopic detail. One single complete isolated mask, same source view, no extra view or board. Entire outline visible on true transparent RGBA. Place it near the center, about78-80% of canvas along its longest axis, with8-12% EMPTY alpha margin above and below the full shell and generous room on the sides. No cast floor shadow, backdrop, wearer or extra object.
